messages:
morgan: heads up — after canary of new routing policy the quota breakdown on console is showing odd splits. noticed tenant "acme" showing 80/20 despite no affinity rules. :eyeglasses:
chen: same, saw spike in "route:fallback" tokens. dashboard seems to be attributing to old header name.
alex: did the SDK header rename go live? I thought it was behind a flag
morgan: python and ts libs pushed the header v2 by default in latest minor. we didn't coordinate console mapping.
priya: any quick repro? screenshots?
morgan: attached but paste: curl -H "X-Route-Pref: v2" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq '.route'
robin: oh that's the mismatch — infra proxy normalizes header to route_hint but SDKs started sending route_pref. We have 2 names in metric pipeline.
taylor: propose temporary shim in console ingestion to accept both keys for 48h then deprecate. low risk.
alex: SDKs can ship fallback header also for 2 releases. python snippet: headers={"X-Route-Pref":"v2","route_hint":"v2"}
priya: telemetry sampling for these events is low; we may miss errors. increase sampling to 100% for affected tag for 2h?
morgan: agree, will spin a dryrun on staging. can someone flag deploy-bot to do canary in us-west1?
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: route-ingest-shim canary -> us-west1 at 2026-03-23T14:32Z :rocket:
chen: update docs and add console note. also add a quickline to SDK changelog about header fallback and timeline.
robin: created issue infra#834 — we should also add a console tile explaining "route header deprecation" so support can field questions.
morgan: thanks team. plan: tmp shim until 2026-04-07, SDK fallback for 2 releases, console tile + docs. I'll post postmortem if anything weird. :thumbsup:
